runtime_capture.mode: read-only JTAG memory snapshots after the first red

root_cause.contract: A direct C2 entry reference is MK_BCODE(global_directory_ordinal), encoded as 0xc000 + 2 * global_directory_ordinal.
root_cause.target_decoder_defect: The target adds the global ordinal without the mandatory BCODE tag scaling by two.
root_cause.host_oracle_defect: The host oracle applies the tag scaling but omits the image directory base.
root_cause.proof_divergence: The target and host models were independently wrong and no parity gate compared either result with MK_BCODE(global_directory_ordinal).

first_reachable_failure.error_match: VM CALL cannot resolve the malformed literal and returns VM_DIRMISS.

root_cause.session_append: No L65S header was present at the first session-image address after the failure, consistent with failure in the immutable compiler call graph before C2 session append publication.

affected_claims.link28_structural_receipt: remains historical structural evidence but does not prove executable direct-entry resolution
affected_claims.hardware_presmoke: failed at the first evaluated form
affected_claims.one_truth_gate: incomplete: it excludes legacy formats but did not prove target/host/global-directory agreement for direct-entry immediates
affected_claims.historical_evidence: must not be rewritten; a correction receipt must bind the new parity gate

bounded_fix_proposal.product_change: Encode kind-4 entry references as MK_BCODE(image_directory_base + local_entry_ordinal).
bounded_fix_proposal.oracle_change: Pass the image directory base into every host direct-value calculation and require the same global BCODE value.
permanent_gate: check all direct-entry resolutions across every image, not a sample
require IS_BCODE(value) and BCODE_IDX(value) == image_directory_base + local_entry_ordinal
pin image-zero and nonzero-image cases with odd and even global ordinals
mutate omitted scaling and omitted image base independently; both must be rejected
make the first REPL arithmetic form a permanent hardware new-surface smoke
bounded_fix_proposal.process: capacity/placement probe first; at most one newly authorized product link after every structural gate is green

claim_limit: Receipt-less fail-fast hardware diagnosis only. It is not an acceptance receipt, capacity authorization, product promotion, C2 completion or release claim.
